title: Sort mail with the on-device model

proofs.run: installed build, network off (Wi-Fi switched off by the lead), Laya chosen in Settings, Decisions: type a description in Needs Reply, press the rerun; then read, as counts only on a private copy of the owner's data, `core state label/<id>/rerun/*` and the number of messages whose filing says decided_by=laya
proofs.pass: the count of messages filed in Needs Reply with decided_by=laya is above 0; the rerun state reads done or its pending figures; no network was needed (Wi-Fi off during the run); the activity monitor shows the model loaded only after the first question
